lap_length.source: Wikipedia, 2023 Singapore Grand Prix: course length 4.940 km (Marina Bay 2023-2024 layout)

comparison.sign_convention: delta_t = elapsed_A - elapsed_B; negative means A is ahead

limitations.message: NORMALIZED_DISTANCE: positions are 10.1B integrated distance divided by the cited lap length, not physical track coordinates
misalignment bound measured at 2 official sector lines only; it can be exceeded between them, so a significant segment is one not explained by the MEASURED misalignment
PROVISIONAL: within-segment misalignment change is bounded by the misalignment bound itself (D = E); not yet calibrated on more real pairs
NO_DATA spans have no delta; nothing is attributed there
intra-segment splits (braking before/during/after, per-phase accumulation) end at changing speed and carry larger alignment uncertainty than the straight-to-straight segment total
typical full-throttle value differs per car (A 99.0, B 100.0): mean throttle differences include calibration, not only driver input
DRS codes are compared for equality only; their open/closed meaning is not verified in this repository
no track geometry: no apex, corner name or corner identity is available

identity_checks: each telemetry sample's session_id and driver_number == its lap's
10.1B synchronize_drivers: both traces from the same session
report, laps and comparison agree on driver and lap numbers
